_comment: Project-level settings for Claude Code / Cowork. User-level settings live in ~/.claude/settings.json and override these for the user; team settings live here and are committed to the repo so any maintainer (human or AI) inherits them.

permissions._comment: Permission rules apply ON TOP OF the user's settings. We deny destructive git operations on main and any direct git push that bypasses a PR. The branch/PR rule is also encoded as a project skill so Claude reads it before doing git work.

env._comment: Hint to Claude that this project uses .NET 10 LTS + Angular + PostgreSQL. Picked up by codebase-aware agents.
